source: Team demo content from the gap analysis (B-2), based on NASA HRP risk 'Decompression sickness'; not medical advice; needs flight-surgeon review

questions.text: Was there a spacewalk or a pressure change in the last 24 hours?
Any numbness, weakness, confusion or trouble speaking?

summary.LOW: Mild pain, probably not from a pressure change. Rest and watch it.
summary.MODERATE: Possible decompression sickness. Stop work, give oxygen and watch closely.
summary.CRITICAL: Serious decompression sickness is likely. Give oxygen and alert the base now.

LOW.text: Rest and keep the painful part still.
Check again in 30 minutes. Start again if the pain grows.

MODERATE.text: Stop all work and rest lying down.
Give oxygen from the emergency kit.
Do not exercise or rub the painful joint.
Watch for numbness, weakness or confusion.
Alert the base if the pain does not ease in 30 minutes.

CRITICAL.text: Give oxygen from the emergency kit.
Keep them still and watch their breathing.

callBaseWhen: Call the base if the pain spreads, or numbness, weakness or confusion starts.
